description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom TextView for displaying log data received through the LogNode interface, including methods for formatting and appending log messages, and chaining log nodes.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that outputs log data received via the LogNode interface, capable of formatting log messages and chaining log nodes.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats and outputs a log message, including priority, tag, message, and optional exception, updating the UI thread.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method to append a string to a StringBuilder if it is not null, with a delimiter.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line in the LogView.
